post.caption:
The Apollo Guidance Computer had a few tens of kilobytes, and its permanent memory was rope memory woven by hand, wire through a ring for one and around it for nought. During the lunar descent it raised 1202 alarms because it was overloaded, and the reason the landing continued is that it had been written to rank tasks, shed the lowest priority work and restart cleanly. Its best moment was knowing what to ignore.
